site.name: המשך תנועה
site.description: המשך תנועה is an Israeli nonprofit building a nationwide network of local community centers, with regular activities for combat veterans after their service: room to meet, move, find direction and build a good life.
site.ogImageAlt: “Come keep moving with us” in beige on navy, with the המשך תנועה mark and name.

footer.about: המשך תנועה is a home for combat veterans, in the reserves and after service: regular meetings built on movement, community and direction — and, on the way, local community centers across Israel.

photos.walk: Two young men walking and talking under eucalyptus trees, smiling. One is in uniform.
